question.plainText: ![Molecule X]https://cracku.in/media/uploads/image_hLkR5nw.png A substituted cyclic acetal that upon mild acidic hydrolysis yields propanal and acetone A molecule X with following structure under mild acidic condition is hydrolysed to produce Y and Z. Identify the correct statements about Y and Z. A. Both Y and Z have same molar mass. B. Y and Z can be distinguished from each other by NaHCO_3. C. Y and Z react with HCN with same rates. D. Y and Z undergo addition reaction with 2,4-DNP. Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

explanation.latex:
Based on the products, (Y) is propanal ($CH_3CH_2CHO$) and (Z) is acetone ($CH_3COCH_3$).
A. True. Propanal and acetone are isomers with the formula $C_3H_6O$ and both have a molar mass of $58\text{ g/mol}$.
B. False. Neither propanal nor acetone reacts with $NaHCO_3$ (this test is for carboxylic acids).
C. False. Aldehydes (propanal) are sterically less hindered and more electrophilic than ketones (acetone), so propanal reacts with HCN faster than acetone.
D. True. Both are carbonyl compounds and will form a precipitate (hydrazone) with 2,4-DNP.
Therefore, only statements A and D are correct.
